meta.title: L2 Angkor — Furnished apartments for monthly rent in Siem Reap
meta.description: Family-run, fully furnished apartments for long-term rent in Siem Reap, Cambodia. Monthly leases, fast Wi-Fi, friendly hosts on site.

hero.title: Your home in Siem Reap
hero.subtitle: Fully furnished apartments for monthly rent, looked after by our family.

about.title: More than a room — a place to belong
paragraphs: L2 Angkor is a small, family-run building in Siem Reap. We live on site and take care of every apartment ourselves, so you always have someone to ask — whether it's a broken light, the best noodle shop nearby or help with a visa question.
Many of our tenants are teachers, NGO workers and professionals who came for a few months and stayed for years. We'd love for you to feel the same.

items.title: Send an enquiry
items.text: Tell us your move-in date and which room you like. We usually reply within a few hours.

items.title: Visit or video call
items.text: Come and see the room in person, or we'll show you around on a video call.

items.title: Sign & pay deposit
items.text: Sign a simple lease and pay the deposit plus your first month's rent.

items.title: Move in
items.text: Collect your keys, meet the family and make yourself at home.

rules: Quiet hours from 10 pm to 7 am
Overnight guests are welcome — please let us know

items.q: What is included in the rent?
items.a: Rent includes the furnished apartment and the services listed for each room, such as Wi-Fi and cleaning. Electricity and water are metered and paid separately each month.

items.q: How long is the minimum lease?
items.a: The minimum lease is 3 months. Longer leases are welcome, and we may offer a better price for 6 or 12 months.
The deposit is one month's rent. It is refunded when you move out, after we check the room together.

items.q: Can I see the room before I decide?
items.a: Of course. Visit us in person, or we can show you the room on a video call through Telegram, WhatsApp or WeChat.
We can't arrange visas ourselves, but we're happy to recommend trusted local agents and share what other tenants have done.
Sorry, we don't allow pets, to keep the rooms clean for everyone.
